allow: Shell(cd /mnt/nvme/my-books/the-tome-of-langdev/chapters && for f in chapter-{1..130}.ltx; do lines=$(wc -l < "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$lines" -lt 50 ]; then echo "EMPTY/SHORT: $f ($lines lines)"; fi; done)

Shell(cd /mnt/nvme/my-books/the-tome-of-langdev/chapters && total=0; for f in chapter-{1..130}.ltx; do lines=$(wc -l < "$f"); total=$((total + lines)); printf "%-20s %5d lines\n" "$f" "$lines"; done; echo "---"; echo "TOTAL: $total lines across 130 chapters")
